headline: Robert Aramayo Addresses Wolverine MCU Rumors
post:

headline: Wonder Girl leads new Arctic Justice League team
post:
DC has announced a brand new team up coming in January 2027. According to Screen Rant, the upcoming Justice League: Arctic Attack Special will feature an unconventional lineup of characters with freezing abilities. 

When a covert mission goes sideways, Wonder Girl Donna Troy must assemble a unique roster of heroes and villains to stop the Frozen Empress. The villain's true identity is Crystal Frost, who debuted in 1978 and grows more powerful by absorbing heat. To counter this, Donna brings together cool-headed operatives to save humanity from a frosty grave. 

Written by Stephanie Williams with art by Dexter Soy, the special issue features characters like Ice, Frost, Mrs. Freeze, Captain Cold, and the Blue Snowman. 

Are you ready for this icy team up?

#JusticeLeague #WonderGirl #DCComics
original_title: DC Announces Unique New Justice League Roster, All Members and Powers

headline: Batman: Mask of the Phantasm Comic Art Sells
post:
Thirty years later, 1993's Batman: Mask of the Phantasm remains a classic among Caped Crusader adventures. A rare piece of original comic art featuring the movie's major twist recently sold at Heritage Auctions for $2,750. Drawn by Mike Parobeck and Rick Burchett in the style of Batman: The Animated Series, the page captures Andrea Beaumont's reveal as the Phantasm alongside a Joker attack and flashback panels.

Would you add this piece to your collection?

#Batman #MaskOfThePhantasm #DCComics
original_title: Batman: Mask of the Phantasm’s Biggest Twist Lives On in This Rare Piece of Original Comic Art

headline: Mothra takes on Marvel's Knull
post:
After nearly a decade as one of Marvel's most powerful villains, the symbiote god Knull has reportedly met his match. In a preview for Godzilla Conquers The Multiverse #5, Doctor Doom places his confidence in Mothra to handle Knull on her own. Surprisingly, Mothra's light easily overpowers the King in Black's darkness during the final battle.

Did you expect Mothra to take down the Symbiote God so quickly? 

#Marvel #Godzilla #Mothra
original_title: 8 Years Later, Marvel's King In Black Finally Meets Someone Stronger

headline: Uncanny X-Men debuts new matching team uniforms
post:
Marvel has just debuted new multicolored, matching costumes for its latest team. According to Screen Rant, *Uncanny X-Men #38* reveals these unified looks for a villainous young mutant group known as the Scavenged. Sarah Gaunt is attempting to shape them into a dark reflection of the famous mutant heroes. Each outfit features a unique central block color and outer accent, complete with masks that obscure their eyes to show how their judgment is being subverted. 🎨

Meanwhile, the upcoming *Maximum X-Men* will also feature matching yellow and blue team costumes for characters like Firestar, Justice, and Betsy Braddock's Butterfly as they take the place of Earth's Mightiest Heroes. It is fascinating to see how different creative teams are utilizing matching uniforms across the franchise right now.

What do you think of these striking new comic designs?

#UncannyXMen #MarvelComics #XMen
original_title: Marvel Officially Debuts X-Men's New Matching Costumes For First Time
